infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Gera Sheriff uses your location to find nearby emergency services such as hospitals, police, and shelters.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Gera Sheriff uses the microphone so you can dictate phrases in the Translator.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Gera Sheriff uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text in the Translator.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Gera Sheriff does not use your photo library. This permission string is required by an included library.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Gera Sheriff to use your location to find nearby emergency services.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Gera Sheriff to use the microphone so you can dictate phrases in the Translator.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Gera Sheriff to use speech recognition to turn your voice into text in the Translator.
